nom: Vichy Dercos Salicylic Acid Anti-Dandruff Serum

avis.titre: Works but so expensive long term
avis.texte: To get the soothing effects, I have to put quite a lot multiple times a day and makes me think that this bottle might not last as long as I want it to. My scalp still gets somewhat itchy but a lot less irritated and sore for sure. 1 bottle will definitely last me about 2-3 weeks sadly which is sooo expensive for a college student like me .

I have a couple dry patches on my scalp and moderate dandruff. This stuff helps soothes my scalp and the dryness. I love the smell of it too!! Scored 72/100 on yuka for those that are into clean ingredients! I love it.

I have used this product for a few weeks and absolutely love it! As someone who suffers from a dry scalp and dandruff (especially in the winter) and has dark hair, the struggle to keep my scalp looking clean is real. I love that this product not only works, but I can instantly feeling it soothe my scalp which makes the biggest difference with my dry and itchy skin. I saw another review complaining of a smell but I had no such issues and I am someone who is sensitive to smells. This product is truly worth every penny and I will be buying it again!

avis.titre: I don't think I can get past the smell
avis.texte: I'm not sure if it works yet. I can't get past the smell of cologne all over my scalp. I don't think I could apply this NEARLY as often as recommended. *gag*
